metadata.description: Bring shut-down mobile games back to life as fully offline memorial builds, and rescue lost game data from player screenshots and screen recordings.

plugins.name: offline-game-revival
plugins.description: Turn server-dead mobile games into offline, playable preservation builds (recon, anchor-asserted patches, local fake server, repack, on-device acceptance) and recover server-side numbers from screenshots/recordings with local keyframes + dedupe + OCR.
